work_limits: Source-free proposal and targeted prior review only. No native payload/count, image, mixed TSV, source corpus, word meaning or experiment. Root owns selection/assessment. Existing22-unit and complete-group assumptions remain conditional.
title: RAW UNREVIEWED: exact upper envelope for globally fixed null-sign erasure with nonempty group payload
summary: For any fixed null subset of the22working signs, every complete retained group must keep at least one non-null sign. Word supports define a weighted hitting-set problem: maximize possible erased token mass and null inventory size over every key simultaneously. This yields conditional broad capacity bounds without a source language or plaintext assignment; it does not identify a null sign or exclude null-only cover groups outside the premise.

design.mechanism: Global context-independent erasing homomorphism, or a fixed preprocessing deletion of designated null units, with a nonempty residual required for EVERY complete written group.
design.unit: One retained complete written group remains a nonempty payload group after null removal. Native word semantics are not assumed.
premises: A fixed subset N of the22working units is erased at every occurrence; no context/page/position dependence.

Every retained observed group is a valid complete group and must contain at least one unit outside N. Empty residuals cannot encode a default word, derive content solely from group existence or be silently dropped.
Non-null units may later map to arbitrary nonempty strings and may be homophonous. Nothing assumes that each is one plaintext letter.
design.necessary_and_sufficient_shape_condition: For every observed wordw with unit supportS(w), S(w) is NOT a subset of N. Equivalently informative setI=alphabet minusN intersects everyS(w). This is sufficient only for nonempty residuals, not for a readable full code.
proof: The concatenated residual is empty exactly when all units ofw are inN.
Every singleton-support whole word (including pure repeated runs) forces its sole unit outsideN. Such obligatory informative units may be removed from the optimization before enumeration.

For fixed positive occurrence weightsn_g, erased mass is sum_{g inN}n_g. Exhaust admissible subsets or solve/replay the equivalent minimum-weight hitting-set certificate to obtain a global upper bound.

Maximum number of null TYPES and maximum erased TOKEN mass are separate objectives and may have different attaining sets. Report both with their own witnesses; do not combine separate maxima into a nonexistent key.
design.smallest_adequate_check: Freeze an already admitted strict whole-group cache and reader-specific panel(s), collect supports and unit token weights, then enumerate only candidates surviving mandatory singleton-support constraints. A direct validator checks every retained group for an alleged optimum and independently proves no higher feasible mass. No source decoder or language control required.
design.outcomes: A small maximum erased fraction excludes every member of this fixed-erasure family claiming greater null mass at once. No feasible nonemptyN would exclude all fixed null units under this contract. A nonzero maximum supplies only capacity; none of its signs is established as null.
design.robustness: If root prospectively adds a recurrent-word sensitivity panel, retain the full panel and every original failure. Do not treat rare words as errors after observing a bound. Unit occurrences, word types and physical leaves remain separate; readers never pooled.
scope_limits: Null-only complete cover words, whitespace carrying a default symbol, empty-source-word conventions, positional nulls, multiunit null phrases, nonhomomorphic cancellations and different unit/group boundaries are outside.
A low erasure budget is not a lower bound on semantic information or proof that most individual glyphs have independently readable meaning.

predecessors.difference: An erasing morphism with nonempty group images was tested against eight FIXED historical plaintext introductions. Here no plaintext is chosen; only the full fixed-null capacity envelope is requested. Its24exactsource failures remain.

Old renderer null licenses were conditioned on annotated atom/path context and used inherited interpretations. They are neither a global null-letter set nor independent evidence that a glyph is semantically empty.
Their non-erasing codeword capacities and singleton consequences remain. Null deletion changes the representation and is not automatically a freeUD code. No oldcodebook minimum is imported.
